verses.original: נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ הִמְלִ֛יךְ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃ וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־ מֶ֔לֶךְ תַּ֗חַת כָּנְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָקִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’ă·šer ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ben- yō·šî·yā·hū him·lîḵ bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lāḵ- me·leḵ ta·ḥaṯ kā·nə·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon {made} Zedekiah son of Josiah the king - of Judah and he reigned . . . in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim

verses.original: ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶל־ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: hū wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ’el- wə·lō šā·ma‘ diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: But he and his officers and the people of the land - refused to obey the words that the LORD - had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet

verses.original: הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יְהוּכַ֣ל בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֤הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֶן־ מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹ֑ר נָ֣א הִתְפַּלֶּל־ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ בַעֲדֵ֔נוּ
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- way·yiš·laḥ yə·hū·ḵal ben- še·lem·yāh wə·’eṯ- ṣə·p̄an·yā·hū hak·kō·hên ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr nā hiṯ·pal·lel- ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ḇa·‘ă·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: Yet King Zedekiah - sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah - and Zephaniah the priest the son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with the message Please pray to the LORD our God for us

verses.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֕הוּ בָּ֥א וְיֹצֵ֖א בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית הַכְּלִיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yir·mə·yā·hū bā wə·yō·ṣê bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ām wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·ṯōw bêṯ hak·kə·lī
verses.literal: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people for they had not yet put him in prison . . .

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְחֵ֥יל יָצָ֣א מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ שִׁמְעָ֔ם וַיֵּ֣עָל֔וּ מֵעַ֖ל עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh wə·ḥêl yā·ṣā mim·miṣ·rā·yim hak·kaś·dîm haṣ·ṣā·rîm yə·rū·šā·lim ’eṯ- way·yiš·mə·‘ū šim·‘ām way·yê·‘ā·lū mê·‘al ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s army had left Egypt and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem - heard the report they withdrew from . . . Jerusalem

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי֙ אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet -

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָמַ֤ר כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֧חַ אֶתְכֶ֛ם לְדָרְשֵׁ֑נִי אֵלַ֖י הִנֵּ֣ה׀ פַּרְעֹ֗ה חֵ֣יל הַיֹּצֵ֤א לְעֶזְרָ֔ה לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצ֖וֹ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar kōh ṯō·mə·rū ’el- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh haš·šō·lê·aḥ ’eṯ·ḵem lə·ḏā·rə·šê·nî ’ê·lay hin·nêh par·‘ōh ḥêl hay·yō·ṣê lə·‘ez·rāh lā·ḵem šāḇ lə·’ar·ṣōw miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD the God of Israel says that you are to tell . . . the king of Judah who sent you to Me Behold Pharaoh’s army which has marched out to help you will go back to its own land of Egypt

verses.original: הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ וְנִלְחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ הַזֹּ֑את הָעִ֣יר וּלְכָדֻ֖הָ וּשְׂרָפֻ֥הָ בָאֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hak·kaś·dîm wə·šā·ḇū wə·nil·ḥă·mū ‘al- haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr ū·lə·ḵā·ḏu·hā ū·śə·rā·p̄u·hā ḇā·’êš
verses.literal: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city They will capture it and burn it down . . .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר אַל־ תַּשִּׁ֤אוּ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים הָלֹ֛ךְ יֵלְכ֥וּ מֵעָלֵ֖ינוּ כִּי־ לֹ֖א יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’al- taš·ši·’ū nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem lê·mōr hak·kaś·dîm hā·lōḵ yê·lə·ḵū mê·‘ā·lê·nū kî- lō yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Do not deceive yourselves by saying The Chaldeans will go away for good . . . . . . for they will not -

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל־ חֵ֤יל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים אִתְּכֶ֔ם מְדֻקָּרִ֑ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְנִ֨שְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּאָהֳלוֹ֙ יָק֔וּמוּ הַזֹּ֖את הָעִ֥יר וְשָֽׂרְפ֛וּ אֶת־ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- hik·kî·ṯem kāl- ḥêl kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ’it·tə·ḵem mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm ’ă·nā·šîm wə·niš·’ă·rū ḇām ’îš bə·’ā·ho·lōw yā·qū·mū haz·zōṯ hā·‘îr wə·śā·rə·p̄ū ’eṯ- bā·’êš
verses.literal: Indeed if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you and only wounded men remained . . . vvv in their tents they would still get up and burn this city down - -

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים חֵ֣יל בְּהֵֽעָלוֹת֙ מֵעַ֖ל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מִפְּנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹֽה׃ס חֵ֥יל
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hak·kaś·dîm ḥêl bə·hê·‘ā·lō·wṯ mê·‘al yə·rū·šā·lim mip·pə·nê par·‘ōh ḥêl
verses.literal: - When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ וַיֵּצֵ֤א מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָלֶ֖כֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן לַחֲלִ֥ק מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū way·yê·ṣê mî·rū·šā·lim lā·le·ḵeṯ ’e·reṣ bin·yā·min la·ḥă·liq miš·šām bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people

verses.original: ה֞וּא וַיְהִי־ בְּשַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת וְשָׁם֙ וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חֲנַנְיָ֑ה וַיִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל׃ אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hū way·hî- bə·ša·‘ar bin·yā·min ba·‘al pə·qi·ḏuṯ wə·šām ū·šə·mōw yir·’î·yāyh ben- še·lem·yāh ben- ḥă·nan·yāh way·yiṯ·pōś ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr ’at·tāh nō·p̄êl ’el- hak·kaś·dîm
verses.literal: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin the captain of the guard - whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah the son of Hananiah seized - [him] . . . and said You are deserting to the Chaldeans

verses.original: שֶׁ֗קֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵינֶ֤נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים יִרְאִיָּיה֙ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ בְּיִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַשָּׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: še·qer yir·mə·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·nen·nî nō·p̄êl ‘al- hak·kaś·dîm yir·’î·yāyh wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ê·lāw way·yiṯ·pōś bə·yir·mə·yā·hū way·ḇi·’ê·hū ’el- haś·śā·rîm
verses.literal: That is a lie Jeremiah replied I am not deserting to the Chaldeans But Irijah would not listen to him instead, he arrested Jeremiah and took him to the officials

verses.original: הַשָּׂרִ֛ים וַיִּקְצְפ֧וּ עַֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְהִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ וְנָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר כִּֽי־ אֹת֥וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְבֵ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·rîm way·yiq·ṣə·p̄ū ‘al- yir·mə·yā·hū wə·hik·kū ’ō·ṯōw wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·w·ṯōw bêṯ hā·’ê·sūr bêṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān has·sō·p̄êr kî- ’ō·ṯōw ‘ā·śū lə·ḇêṯ hak·ke·le
verses.literal: The officials were angry with Jeremiah and they beat him and placed him in jail . . . in the house of Jonathan the scribe for - it had been made into a prison . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ בָ֧א אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַבּ֖וֹר וְאֶל־ הַֽחֲנֻ֑יוֹת וַיֵּֽשֶׁב־ שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ רַבִּֽים׃פ יָמִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kî yir·mə·yā·hū ḇā ’el- bêṯ hab·bō·wr wə·’el- ha·ḥă·nu·yō·wṯ way·yê·šeḇ- šām yir·mə·yā·hū rab·bîm yā·mîm
verses.literal: So Jeremiah went into a cell . . . in the dungeon and remained there . . . a long time . . .

verses.original: הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ וַיִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ֙ וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֨הוּ בַּסֵּ֔תֶר הֲיֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה יֵ֔שׁ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר וַיֹּ֤אמֶר תִּנָּתֵֽן׃ס בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū ham·me·leḵ bə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yiš·’ā·lê·hū bas·sê·ṯer hă·yêš dā·ḇār mê·’êṯ Yah·weh yêš way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū way·yō·mer way·yō·mer tin·nā·ṯên bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Later, King Zedekiah sent for [Jeremiah] and received him in his palace where he asked him privately Is there a word - from the LORD There is . . . Jeremiah replied . . . You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֑הוּ מֶה֩ חָטָ֨אתִֽי לְךָ֤ וְלַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְלָעָ֣ם כִּֽי־ נְתַתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: yir·mə·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’el- ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū meh ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lə·ḵā wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā haz·zeh wə·lā·‘ām kî- nə·ṯat·tem ’ō·w·ṯî ’el- bêṯ hak·ke·le
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah asked . . . King Zedekiah How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people that you have put me in prison . . .

verses.original: וְאַיּוֹ נְבִ֣יאֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִבְּא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ לֹֽא־ יָבֹ֤א עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל הַזֹּֽאת׃ הָאָ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾay·yō nə·ḇî·’ê·ḵem ’ă·šer- nib·bə·’ū lā·ḵem lê·mōr me·leḵ- bā·ḇel lō- yā·ḇō ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘al haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you claiming The king of Babylon will not come against you . . . or this land

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה נָ֖א שְֽׁמַֽע־ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ תְחִנָּתִי֙ תִּפָּל־ נָ֤א לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַל־ תְּשִׁבֵ֗נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nā šə·ma‘- ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ṯə·ḥin·nā·ṯî tip·pāl- nā lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·’al- tə·ši·ḇê·nî bêṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān has·sō·p̄êr wə·lō ’ā·mūṯ šām
verses.literal: But now please listen O my lord the king May my petition come . . . before you Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe or I will die there

verses.original: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיְצַוֶּ֞ה יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ וַיַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת־ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וְנָתֹן֩ ל֨וֹ כִכַּר־ לֶ֤חֶם לַיּוֹם֙ מִן־ מִח֣וּץ הָאֹפִ֔ים עַד־ כָּל־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם הָעִ֑יר תֹּ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּחֲצַ֖ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·ṣaw·weh yir·mə·yā·hū way·yap̄·qi·ḏū ’eṯ- ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh wə·nā·ṯōn lōw ḵik·kar- le·ḥem lay·yō·wm min- mi·ḥūṣ hā·’ō·p̄îm ‘aḏ- kāl- hal·le·ḥem hā·‘îr tōm yir·mə·yā·hū way·yê·šeḇ ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: So King Zedekiah gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed - in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers until all the bread in the city was gone So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard
